Oracle AI Rollout Challenges and Financial Scrutiny

Oracle's recent artificial intelligence rollout faced internal challenges, with an executive acknowledging that the process did not go smoothly. The company's financial performance and the effectiveness of its AI implementation are under scrutiny.
